meta_title: Agent Caffeine · Keep your Mac awake while AI agents work
meta_description: Agent Caffeine keeps your Mac awake while AI coding agents work, also with the lid closed, and lets it sleep when they are done. Free for 7 days, then {price} once.
meta_share_description: Keep your Mac awake while AI agents work. Agent-aware sleep prevention for macOS. Free for 7 days, then {price} once.
meta_share_image_alt: Agent Caffeine. Close your lid, come back to finished work
footer_tagline: Keeps your Mac awake while your agents work

agents_lead: It finds more than {count} agents by itself, with no setup. You can add your own
sleep_title: It lets your Mac sleep at the right time
sleep_lead: It keeps your Mac awake for work, and for nothing else
sleep_waiting_title: An agent asks you something while you are away
sleep_waiting_text: Agent Caffeine keeps your Mac awake for 5 minutes, so you can answer. After that your Mac can sleep. You can change the time
sleep_waiting_label: The Agent Caffeine menu while Claude Code waits for you
sleep_waiting_reason: Claude Code is waiting for you, for at least 1 more minute
sleep_lid_title: The lid is closed and your Mac runs on battery
sleep_lid_text: Your agents keep working. On battery, macOS asks you once to allow a small helper. Agent Caffeine lets your Mac sleep at {floor}% battery and when it gets too hot
sleep_notification_text: Agent Caffeine let your Mac sleep because the battery is at {floor}%
sleep_sessions_title: 10 sessions are open and 1 is working
sleep_sessions_text: A session is one open chat with an agent. Only the one that works keeps your Mac awake
sleep_sessions_label: The Agent Caffeine menu with one working session and nine idle ones
small_lead: Each one is in the menu or in Settings
small_lid_title: The display dims as the lid closes
small_lid_text: It dims from 45 degrees and is off with the lid closed, so it does not use battery or warm your Mac
small_lid_label: A laptop from the side at three lid angles. At 105 degrees the display is bright, at 24 degrees it is at half brightness, and with the lid closed it is off
small_sound_title: A sound tells you your Mac stays awake
small_sound_text: Close the lid while an agent works and you hear one short sound. No sound means your Mac goes to sleep. You can pick the sound or turn it off
small_sound_label: The sound for a closed lid in Settings: the switch is on and the sound is Tink
small_sound_switch: Play a sound when you close the lid and your Mac stays awake
small_reach_text: Your Mac stays awake for 1, 2 or 4 hours, so a message from your phone reaches your agent
small_reach_label: The Agent Caffeine menu while your Mac stays reachable until 11:41
small_pause_text: Pause for 30 minutes, 1 hour or until tomorrow. Agent Caffeine starts again by itself
small_pause_label: The timer menu: pause for 30 minutes, for 1 hour or until tomorrow
small_notify_title: It tells you when an agent needs you
small_notify_text: A notification when an agent waits for your answer, and one when it finishes. Each has its own switch
small_notify_label: A notification from Agent Caffeine: Claude Code is waiting for you
small_notify_waiting: Claude Code is waiting for you
small_notify_body: Agent Caffeine keeps your Mac awake for 5 more minutes
small_battery_title: You see how much battery is left
small_battery_text: On battery the menu shows the charge, and the level where Agent Caffeine lets your Mac sleep
small_battery_label: The line of the battery in the Agent Caffeine menu
small_keys_text: Turn Agent Caffeine on or off, or pause it for 1 hour, from any app. You can change the keys
small_key_toggle: Turn Agent Caffeine on or off
demo_lead: Pick a situation and see what Agent Caffeine does
demo_time_note: Time runs faster here. In the app an agent that waits for you keeps your Mac awake for 5 minutes, and you can change that time
